headline: KSE-100 surged ~3% (+5,200 pts to ~176,200) Monday morning on a further 4-5% oil-price drop tied to Pakistan-brokered US-Iran de-escalation talks, pulling the drawdown from the Jan ATH back to ~7% — clear of the 10% correction line; SBP's first FY27 MPC meets today, 97% of analysts expect a hold at 11.5%; Mali's price feed hasn't posted today's intraday move yet (still shows Friday's Rs 31.33 AVN close as of 1:25pm PKT) so per-holding figures below are Friday's close; AVN's sell-half plan is due today — verify the live price before executing; EFERT H1 results now just 2 days out (Wed Jul 29)
market: Big reversal Monday: after three straight losing sessions and a slide toward a 10% correction, the KSE-100 opened higher and extended to an intraday +5,211 points (+3.05%), touching ~176,232 by midday, on news that Pakistan-brokered mediation is pushing US-Iran talks forward and Brent crude extended Friday's plunge with another 4-5% drop — easing the oil-import/inflation pressure that had been driving the selloff. Buying was broad-based: automobile assemblers, cement, commercial banks, E&P, OMCs and power generation all saw strong interest. Against the Jan 23, 2026 all-time high of 189,556, a ~176,200 level puts the drawdown at roughly 7% — a meaningful retreat from Friday's ~9.8%, back clear of the 10% line that triggers the dry-powder deployment plan. SBP's MPC holds its first FY27 meeting today (Jul 27); a Topline Securities poll has 97% of analysts expecting the policy rate held at 11.5%, with June CPI having eased to 11.1% even as core inflation stays elevated (8.7% urban, 7.9% rural) — no rate decision confirmed as of this review's research pass. Caveat: Mali's own price feed (data/prices.json) has not posted an intraday update for today's session yet at review time (1:25pm PKT) — it still shows Friday Jul 24's closing prices carried through the weekend, so the per-holding P/L figures below reflect Friday's close, not today's rally; treat AVN's Rs 31.33 and the ~+1.2% portfolio return as a floor, not today's actual mark. AVN's sell-half plan (flagged for nine straight reviews now) is due today regardless — check the live PSX quote before placing the order, since a market-wide 3% rally may have lifted it off Friday's low too. EFERT's board still meets Wed Jul 29, 9am for H1 results/dividend — now inside 2 days, worth checking again before it's due. CPHL's REIT demerger remains exactly where it was Jul 8 (board-approved transfer of two Lahore properties into the Citi Core Holdings SPV for 331.72M shares; awaiting the next regulatory/shareholder step) — no movement since. No ex-dividend dates found within the next 3 days for any holding (MEBL's next ex-div isn't expected until around August).
